title: Fizza teri wafa ki had
body:
Kaniz-e-Zahra, Janabe Fizza, Wafa ki malka, Janab-e-Fizza
<<MINI>>
Fizza teri wafa ki, hadd akhri yahi he
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ke sath tu bhi, bazaar me khari he
<<MINI>>
Fizza teri wafa ki, hadd akhri yahi he
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu ne toh sayyadon ka abaad ghar bhi dekha Aur kis tarha huwa woh barbaad ghar bhi dekha
Tu phir bhi noukri se, peeche nahi hati he
<<MINI>>
Fizza teri wafa ki, hadd akhri yahi he
<<DIVIDER>>
Ungli pakar ke teri, Zainab ne chal na seekha
Ek waqt woh bhi aya, Zainab ke saath Fizza
Jakri huwi rasan me, kanton pe tu chali he
<<MINI>>
Fizza teri wafa ki, hadd akhri yahi he
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu habsh ki he maleka, sab jaante he bibi
Qadmon me thi tumhare, daulat jahan ki sari Phir bhi kaniz-e-Zahra tu fakhr se bani hai
<<MINI>>
Fizza teri wafa ki, hadd akhri yahi he
<<DIVIDER>>
Har ek qadam pe tu ne, Zainab ko he bachaya
Bibi pe aane wala, pathar he tu ne khaya
Teri jabeen Fizza, zakhmon se bhar gayi he
<<MINI>>
Fizza teri wafa ki, had akhri yahi he
<<DIVIDER>>
Sun kar wafat-e-Abid khud bhi rahi na zinda
Bazar e Shaam me tha, bibi tumhara laasha
Mayyat tumhari bibi, Baqar ne dafn ki he
<<MINI>>
Fizza teri wafa ki, hadd akhri yahi he
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay Arsalan aur Mesum hoti he pursadari
Jab kaarvan Baqayya, aate hein baari baari
Fizza bhi za’iron ke, hum raah matami he
<<MINI>>
Fizza teri wafa ki, hadd akhri yahi he
